releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.7.0 — Symbol & Typography Sanitization:
• Complete eradication of all corrupted mojibake encoding artifacts and broken symbols across all engines, dialogs, and UI cards.
• Pristine UTF-8 with BOM standard throughout the entire codebase.
• OmniNeural v4 (18-Agent Autonomous Mesh) fully active for Gaming, Work, and Battery orchestration.
• 5 Master Hubs with clean sub-navigation viewports and zero vertical scrolling.
• Scrollable In-App Update Dialog with fixed bottom buttons.
